sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s by start of classes; minimum GPA 3.0/4.0. Math preparation comparable to Berkeley major
expected, including real/complex analysis and abstract/linear algebra. UChicago math degree is an eligible
route, subject to transcript review. [s3] [s2] [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare two essays, transcripts and three online referees; send required Math GRE. Application opened 24
September 2026 at noon Pacific. Choose Mathematics PhD, not internal-only MA. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SOP asks for aligned faculty. No prior supervisor agreement listed; admissions decisions by committee.
Department does not offer individual counseling on strengthening chances. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use status page for scores, letters, fee and decision. After submission, contact department for additional
materials/changes; system normally disallows late applicant submission. [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit Fall 2027 deadline and required Math GRE; FAQ international-waiver paragraph still says 2026, but
main page explicitly updates to 2027. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
1 December 2026, 8:59 p.m. Pacific Time. This is earlier than midnight. Final official degree records after
admission have a standing 1 October deadline, separate from application uploads. [s1] [s7]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Ordinary package considered at admission without separate funding application. UC fellowship
procedures/deadlines appear within application; no independently verified later fellowship deadline. [s5] [s6]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Same deadline as application. Upload links remain active afterward, but late letters not guaranteed available
when review begins; on-time applicant still considered with limited information if a letter missing. [s2]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Official scores due application deadline; department recommends tests no later than October to allow
transmission. ETS code 4833, no department code. [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Exact Fall 2027 mathematics commitment date not established by current pages reviewed. Use offer-specific
SIR/fellowship instructions; do not import another Berkeley department’s date. [s7]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
For fall 2027 if not exempt: TOEFL iBT/Home Edition or IELTS; no DET/ITP/MyBest/IELTS Indicator or One Test
Retake. TOEFL taken from 21 January 2026 needs total5, speaking/writing4.5; IELTS total7,
speaking/writing6.5. Tests before 1 June 2025 invalid. [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
US English-medium accredited degree qualifies; alternatively, at least one completed year of full-time US
academic coursework with B-or-better grades qualifies before application. In-progress future courses cannot
count. Upload transcripts; evaluators determine exemption, no separate math form. Teaching oral proficiency
is a separate requirement. [s3] [s2]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional: may submit, only Math Subject required. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Conflict]
Required for Fall 2027. Official pages conflict on illustrative low-score percentile: main admissions says
below70th; FAQ below50th. Neither is stated as an absolute eligibility cutoff. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No math-specific annual cash stipend/2027-28 rate, guaranteed summer amount or exact tuition/NRST/health
breakdown published in reviewed funding pages. Detailed package provided with admission. Do not substitute
general union pay scale for guaranteed mathematics offer. Published UC contract Table B.2 provides Berkeley
Group 2, salary point 1, 50% TA/GSI semester appointment USD 3,890.70/month effective October 1, 2026 and
USD 3,988.80/month effective October 1, 2027. These are contractual monthly appointment rates, not a
promised 12-month Mathematics package; actual paid months, step, summer fellowship and appointment mix
determine annual support. [s5] [s6] [ucwages27]
Years of support [Standing rule]
At least five years, conditional on good degree progress and satisfactory teaching. [s5]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department pledge to incoming PhD students is not restricted to citizens; international GSI pathway explicitly
described. International aid terms/NRST coverage must be checked in offer. FAFSA/California-residency
instruction applies to domestic students. [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
GSI normally20hours/week; first-time GSIs take MPS375 and meet spoken-English requirements. GSRs mostly
post-candidacy and appointed term by term. Department does not cover summer course enrollment except
qualifying F1 CPT internship units. [s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary support automatic with admissions consideration. UC fellowship financial information in admissions
application may be required. [s5] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Fellowships, GSI, faculty-grant GSR and supplemental reader work. Outside fellowships encouraged; NSF
examples on department page are not a declaration of international eligibility. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International applicant USD155 plus4.22% processing fee (calculated totalUSD161.54 after cent rounding).
Nonrefundable, credit-card payment via status portal. FAQ requires payment/approved waiver within3days of
deadline; safest to pay at submission. [s3] [s4]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
Math explicitly cannot accommodate international fee-waiver requests for Fall 2027. Central waiver eligibility
restricted to US citizens/current permanent residents with qualifying need/program participation. UChicago
enrollment/F1 does not meet citizenship condition. [s1] [s3]

text:
University of California, Berkeley
United States · Mathematics PhD
2026 US News roster/rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Deadline 8:59p.m. Pacific, not 11:59p.m.
• Math GRE required; international fee waiver explicitly unavailable for 2027.
• Berkeley thesis directory lists student plus adviser under Author; these are not automatically coauthored
papers.
• Ribet, Vojta, Hartshorne, Ogus, Reshetikhin and Sturmfels are emeritus in current directory; excluded from
ordinary-adviser shortlist.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Bachelor’s by start of classes; minimum GPA 3.0/4.0. Math preparation comparable to Berkeley major
expected, including real/complex analysis and abstract/linear algebra. UChicago math degree is an eligible
route, subject to transcript review. [s3] [s2] [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare two essays, transcripts and three online referees; send required Math GRE. Application opened 24
September 2026 at noon Pacific. Choose Mathematics PhD, not internal-only MA. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
SOP asks for aligned faculty. No prior supervisor agreement listed; admissions decisions by committee.
Department does not offer individual counseling on strengthening chances. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use status page for scores, letters, fee and decision. After submission, contact department for additional
materials/changes; system normally disallows late applicant submission. [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit Fall 2027 deadline and required Math GRE; FAQ international-waiver paragraph still says 2026, but
main page explicitly updates to 2027. [s1] [s2]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
1 December 2026, 8:59 p.m. Pacific Time. This is earlier than midnight. Final official degree records after
admission have a standing 1 October deadline, separate from application uploads. [s1] [s7]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Ordinary package considered at admission without separate funding application. UC fellowship
procedures/deadlines appear within application; no independently verified later fellowship deadline. [s5] [s6]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Same deadline as application. Upload links remain active afterward, but late letters not guaranteed available
when review begins; on-time applicant still considered with limited information if a letter missing. [s2]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Official scores due application deadline; department recommends tests no later than October to allow
transmission. ETS code 4833, no department code. [s1]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Exact Fall 2027 mathematics commitment date not established by current pages reviewed. Use offer-specific
SIR/fellowship instructions; do not import another Berkeley department’s date. [s7]
English and GRE
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
For fall 2027 if not exempt: TOEFL iBT/Home Edition or IELTS; no DET/ITP/MyBest/IELTS Indicator or One Test
Retake. TOEFL taken from 21 January 2026 needs total5, speaking/writing4.5; IELTS total7,
speaking/writing6.5. Tests before 1 June 2025 invalid. [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
US English-medium accredited degree qualifies; alternatively, at least one completed year of full-time US
academic coursework with B-or-better grades qualifies before application. In-progress future courses cannot
count. Upload transcripts; evaluators determine exemption, no separate math form. Teaching oral proficiency
is a separate requirement. [s3] [s2]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Optional: may submit, only Math Subject required. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Conflict]
Required for Fall 2027. Official pages conflict on illustrative low-score percentile: main admissions says
below70th; FAQ below50th. Neither is stated as an absolute eligibility cutoff. [s1] [s2]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Unofficial scans from every postsecondary school, including summer/extension/community-college attendance.
Must identify applicant/institution; official records only after admission. No GPA worksheet required; do not
convert a non-4-point GPA. [s3] [s2]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics course-list or course-description file specified in reviewed math admissions/FAQ and
central checklist. Portal-only request, template, format and length remain unverified; do not borrow Berkeley
Statistics requirements. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three electronic letters; no mailed letters. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No extra ordinary funding references identified; scholarship-specific portal questions/reference needs not
publicly established. [s5] [s6]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Enter referee and send invitation on Recommendations page; system then emails unique link. Mere unsent
data entry is not documented as sufficient. [s4]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Can invite before submission and submit while letters pending; reminders remain available afterward. [s4]

Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Email confirms letter upload; status portal displays receipt. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Before upload, exclude original entry and create replacement to change details/FERPA; old link deactivated.
Additional recommenders after submission subject to existing-letter restriction described in FAQ. Interfolio
accepted with unique document email. Already-submitted replacement and later-cycle reuse not verified. [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Separate CV requirement, length and formatting not established in public math checklist; inspect current portal
before drafting. [s1] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required. Department guidance: typically1,000-1,500 words,2-3 single-spaced pages (guidance rather than
stated hard cap). Prompt paraphrase: mathematical interests/questions, research/academic preparation, future
trajectory, faculty/program fit, and relevant experience overcoming barriers or contributing to community. Full
detailed departmental structure linked. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required personal history; department guidance typically500-1,000 words. Prompt paraphrase: formative
motivation, personal/cultural/family/educational context and challenges, leadership/service, contribution to
Berkeley community. Font/file constraints beyond online submission not published. [s1] [s9]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Included in SOP: research areas/questions, future goals and relevant Berkeley faculty. No separately specified
research statement. [s1]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Other short
answers / materials [Unresolved]
No separate item/length/format or paper upload-versus-link rule established on public math admissions/FAQ or
central checklist. Confirm current portal rather than inferring permission. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics course-list or course-description file specified in reviewed math admissions/FAQ and
central checklist. Portal-only request, template, format and length remain unverified; do not borrow Berkeley
Statistics requirements. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
UC fellowship section may request financial-status information; exact additional prompts/limits not exposed in
reviewed public pages. Ordinary package has no separate funding application. [s5] [s6]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No math-specific annual cash stipend/2027-28 rate, guaranteed summer amount or exact tuition/NRST/health
breakdown published in reviewed funding pages. Detailed package provided with admission. Do not substitute
general union pay scale for guaranteed mathematics offer. Published UC contract Table B.2 provides Berkeley
Group 2, salary point 1, 50% TA/GSI semester appointment USD 3,890.70/month effective October 1, 2026 and
USD 3,988.80/month effective October 1, 2027. These are contractual monthly appointment rates, not a
promised 12-month Mathematics package; actual paid months, step, summer fellowship and appointment mix
determine annual support. [s5] [s6] [ucwages27]
Years of support [Standing rule]
At least five years, conditional on good degree progress and satisfactory teaching. [s5]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department pledge to incoming PhD students is not restricted to citizens; international GSI pathway explicitly
described. International aid terms/NRST coverage must be checked in offer. FAFSA/California-residency
instruction applies to domestic students. [s5]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
GSI normally20hours/week; first-time GSIs take MPS375 and meet spoken-English requirements. GSRs mostly
post-candidacy and appointed term by term. Department does not cover summer course enrollment except
qualifying F1 CPT internship units. [s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Ordinary support automatic with admissions consideration. UC fellowship financial information in admissions
application may be required. [s5] [s6]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Fellowships, GSI, faculty-grant GSR and supplemental reader work. Outside fellowships encouraged; NSF
examples on department page are not a declaration of international eligibility. [s5]
Application fee [Standing rule]
International applicant USD155 plus4.22% processing fee (calculated totalUSD161.54 after cent rounding).
Nonrefundable, credit-card payment via status portal. FAQ requires payment/approved waiver within3days of
deadline; safest to pay at submission. [s3] [s4]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
Math explicitly cannot accommodate international fee-waiver requests for Fall 2027. Central waiver eligibility
restricted to US citizens/current permanent residents with qualifying need/program participation. UChicago
enrollment/F1 does not meet citizenship condition. [s1] [s3]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
GRE low-score illustration70th versus50th percentile; use required-test rule, not either number as hard cutoff.
Central process page says pay by deadline, FAQ says within3days; pay immediately. Faculty directory calls
Feng assistant professor while his September 2026 official homepage says associate; use latter. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Check current portal CV/course-list/optional-work fields and fellowship prompts; obtain exact 2027
funding/NRST/summer and response date from offer. Verify new-student supervision capacity, especially joint
appointments and older publication lists. [s1] [s5] [s7]
